_doc: Arabic index keywords for knowledge-base topics (R1, 2026-11-25). SEARCH INDEX ONLY, never displayed as content. Each keyword is a term that OCCURS in that topic's own extracted text (title, summary, definition, explanation, rules, procedures, examples, key points, subsections) but is ABSENT from the topic's title, so title-first ranking missed questions that naturally phrase the topic with that word. The builder verifies every keyword mechanically against the topic's extracted text and FAILS LOUDLY on any keyword that does not occur there (see tools/build_db.py). Only the 5 topics below need Arabic keywords; every other topic's title already carries its natural question words. Rationale per topic: P1C1-M2 (B01 asks with علاقات/دول/مجاملة, all in its definition); P2C1-M4 (A01/A19 ask with مطار/وصول, in its procedures); P1C2-M4 (C09 asks with مؤتمر/فيينا/تطور, in its summary); P2C1-M3 (C19 asks with استقبال/اجتماعات/توديع/دولة/وفد/برنامج, in its text); P2C1-M2-04 (C20/A10 ask with سفير/أوراق/اعتماد/تاريخ, in its text). Terms NOT added because they do not occur in the topic's text at all: وفد in P2C1-M4 (0 occurrences), اتفاقية/1961 in P1C2-M4 (0), مطار/أسبقية in P2C1-M3 (0), طبقة/طبقات in P2C1-M2-04 (0), اجتماعية/يميز in P1C1-M2 (0).
